messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT — elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (us-west1). Paging tara (on-call). Potential customer impact: failed requests and timeouts.

tara: oncall here, looking. seeing spike in 502/504s at the load balancer. link to grafana?

andrew: grabbing LB logs now. tail shows connection reset -> upstream container restarts around the same time.

mira: grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/abc123/generate-errors (filtered by region=us-west1). throwing this query into logs now:
```
index=prod-app logs=lb | where path="/v1/generate" and status>=500 | stats count() by status, service, instance | sort -count
```

leo: quick note: sampling for app logs was reduced to 10% earlier today to cut costs. that will hide some request-level traces.

ops-eng: that was me, reduced at 15:12 to 0.1 to throttle bulk sampling during the batch ingest. flipping back to 1.0 now.

tara: please call out any missing spans/traces — we need full timeline for affected customers. andrew, can you confirm if container restarts correlate with LB 5xx spikes?

andrew: yes, correlating. container restarts on model-host group at ~15:46 UTC. logs show OOM-kill on worker-2 then immediate restart. attaching snippet:
```
Mar 23 15:46:12 host-2 kubelet: container "model-host" OOMKilled
Mar 23 15:46:13 host-2 kubelet: starting container model-host
Mar 23 15:46:20 host-2 model-host: incoming requests queue length spike > 200
```

mira: customer impact check — product metrics show ~8% request failures for paid tier (+increased latency) between 15:45-15:52. sending note to cs: "some customers may see failed generations during that window" :warning:

sre-bot: auto-run: running quick health checks and collecting pod logs. artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/snapshots/1762501234/

leo: missing logs problem — because sampling was 0.1, some of the exact request IDs are not present in the central index. i'm running a targeted pull from node local logs for host-2. if we don't have request IDs, we need s3 raw logs (ask ops).

ops-eng: initiating raw log dump for host-2 (s3://redwood-raw/logs/host-2/2026-03-23/). ETA ~6 mins.

tara: mitigation done? any quick fixes to reduce customer impact now? can we scale model-host pool or enable fallback variant?

andrew: scaling model-host +2 replicas helps absorb backlog. starting canary fallback to smaller model (quantized) for non-enterprise routes to reduce latency. applying policy: route tier != enterprise -> fallback.

mira: sending a short customer-facing blurb to CS: "We observed an elevated error rate on text generation endpoints between 15:45-15:52 UTC. We mitigated by scaling hosts and enabling fallback routes; investigating root cause. No persistent data loss."

tara: timeline summary (for handoff):
- 15:12 UTC: sampling reduced to 10% (ops-eng)
- 15:45 UTC: LB spikes 502/504s start
- 15:46 UTC: OOM kill on model-host worker-2 -> restarts (andrew)
- 15:47 UTC: error rate peaks (~8% failures for some customers)
- 15:50 UTC: ops-eng restores sampling to 100%
- 15:51 UTC: scale +2 replicas; enable fallback routing (andrew)
- 15:52 UTC: error rate begins to decline

leo: taking over the incident for the night shift. items for RCA:
- collect full raw logs for host-2 and surrounding nodes (ops-eng)
- confirm what triggered OOM (memory leak? spike in payload size?) (andrew + mira)
- correlate request IDs to customer error reports and CS tickets (mira)
- investigate sampler config change process to avoid blind spots (infra + oncall process)

ops-eng: raw logs dump started, will upload links to artifact when ready. also will revert sampling-change runbook to require oncall ack for production windows.

tara: handing off to leo — short summary: customer-facing errors due to host OOMs; sampling change reduced observability which delayed correlation; mitigations applied (scale + fallback). see artifacts and raw logs.

leo: acknowledged. I'll own post-incident analysis and draft RCA. assigning follow-ups in tracker. ping me for anything urgent overnight. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: incident state -> monitoring. severity -> Sev2. ticket created: INC-2026-0423-176250.

tara: thanks team. quick note: in the RCA please call out: (1) why OOM happened (2) why sampling change wasn't visible in runbook (3) how to prevent blind spots during high-impact windows.

leo: got it. starting a working thread for timeline and hypotheses in the RCA doc.
